description: Analyze design references from URLs (browser automation + screenshots) and/or attached images. Extracts colors, typography, layout patterns, and UI components. When multiple references are provided, identifies common patterns across all sources to prioritize consistent design decisions for UI/UX generation.

images.description: Attached images to analyze as design references

label.description: Optional label for this image reference

update_context.description: Whether to update the global design context with detected patterns

urls.description: URLs of websites to scrape for design references (screenshots + computed styles)

viewport.description: Browser viewport size for URL scraping

name: analyze_design_references
